graham.brief:
There's no headline in  at , only a mismatch between two units. San Francisco carries the 6th-heaviest injury load in the league. Strength meets weakness in San Francisco.

Denver's pass defense has been quietly good, 6th-best in the league against the pass. Bo Nix's pass attempts climbed from 31 to 34.

CBS Sports NFL Headlines reports 49ers' Mike Evans ruled out with injury after taking a hit against Cardinals. Brock Purdy is the starter who's played 92% of the snaps. Purdy's line is 30.5 pass attempts, above the 27.7 he's averaging. They've set Christian McCaffrey at 13.5 rush attempts, above the 11.7 he's averaging.

The question is whether San Francisco's plan survives contact with the scoreboard.
